title: A2 word list · adjectives
note: A2 adjectives · COR · carriers via use[]

intro.title: Words that describe
intro.body:
314 describing words — adjectives. Almost all of them sit after is or am: The bag is empty. I am tired.
Almost every one can describe a thing (It is …). About half can also describe a person (I am …). Same frame, two different jobs.
intro.body_cz: 314 přídavných jmen. Skoro všechna stojí po is nebo am. Většina popisuje věci, asi polovina i lidi.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: un- turns a describing word into its opposite: able → unable, fair → unfair, likely → unlikely, usual → unusual. Learn them as pairs, not as separate words.
intro.note_cz: Předpona un- vytváří opak: able → unable, fair → unfair. Učte se je v párech.
